title: Retro Snake
description: The timeless classic. Eat the red apples, grow longer, and avoid hitting the walls or your own tail!
controls: Arrow Keys or On-Screen Touch Buttons

title: Cyber Pong
description: The original arcade table tennis. Play against an AI opponent and score 5 points to win.I bet that you can't win
controls: Mouse movements / Drag finger on Touch Screen

title: Space Clicker
description: An addictive, infinite clicker game. Click the core, gather energy, and buy automated upgrades.
controls: Left Mouse Click / Tap on Screen

title: Tic-Tac-Toe
description: The classic grid puzzle. Get 3 of your signs in a row (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) before the computer does.
controls: Click or Tap on empty squares

title: Mini Chess
description: (its very buggy)A lightweight strategic chess board engine. Move your white pieces and capture the black CPU army.Btw you can fly!
controls: Click/Tap a piece to select, then click target square

title: T-Rex Runner
description: The legendary Google Chrome offline dinosaur game.(or how do you want to call that freaking creature) Help the pixelated T-Rex run as far as possible.
controls: Press SPACEBAR or Tap anywhere on screen to JUMP
